class.name: NNBlackboard
class.brief_description: A key/value data store shared by AI agents, behaviour trees, state trees, and HTN planners.
class.description: A [Resource] that stores named [String] keys and [Variant] values for AI nodes to share state without coupling them together. Assign it to a root's [code]assigned_blackboard[/code] property to share state across roots, pre-populate initial values in the inspector, or attach an [NNBlackboardSchema] for type validation and defaults. If you do not assign one, outermost roots create a private blackboard automatically. [member Resource.resource_local_to_scene] defaults to [code]true[/code] so each instanced character gets its own copy. Uncheck it if you want multiple instances to share one blackboard (for example, squad-level memory).

method.name: apply_values
method.description: Merges [param values] into the blackboard atomically. If any key is invalid or rejected by [member schema], nothing is changed and [code]false[/code] is returned. Otherwise writes changed entries and emits [signal value_changed] for each updated key after all writes complete.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all keys and emits [signal cleared] if the blackboard was non-empty.

method.name: erase_value
method.description: Removes [param key] and emits [signal value_erased]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the key did not exist.

method.name: get_debug_data
method.description: Returns a safe, serializable copy of the blackboard for debugging, replacing [Object] references with class names or resource metadata and capping recursion depth.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key], or [param default_value] if the key is missing or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param key] exists and its value is not [code]null[/code].

method.name: keys
method.description: Returns all stored keys, including keys whose value is [code]null[/code].

method.name: set_value
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key] and emits [signal value_changed] if the value changed. Returns [code]false[/code] if [param key] is empty or rejected by [member schema].

members.member: Optional [NNBlackboardSchema] used to validate writes and populate default values for absent keys. Set to [code]null[/code] to allow any keys and types.
The underlying key/value dictionary. Replacing this dictionary validates against [member schema] (if set), fills in schema defaults for absent keys, and does not emit change signals.

signal.name: cleared
signal.description: Emitted by [method clear] when the blackboard was non-empty.

signal.name: value_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [param key] is written with a different value via [method set_value] or [method apply_values].

signal.name: value_erased
signal.description: Emitted when an existing [param key] is removed by [method erase_value].
